# Release checklist

<!-- lark:block:s01 -->
## Scope

<!-- lark:block:s02 -->
This release covers the reader hardening work only. The writer changes that were originally planned for this release have been moved out, because the review found that they were not ready and would have needed another round of testing that there was simply not enough time for in this particular window.

<!-- lark:block:s03 -->
The rollout is staged: early consumers first, then the wider set.

<!-- lark:block:s04 -->
